place.name: Mar-a-Lago
place.description: The Mar-a-Lago Club ( MAR ə LAH-goh, Spanish: [ˈmaɾ a ˈlaɣo]) is a resort and National Historic Landmark on a barrier island in Palm Beach, Florida, United States. It has 126 rooms and an area of 62,500 square feet (5,810 square meters) built on 17 acres (7 hectares) of land.
